name: peta-board
description: Development checks for the standalone offline HTML application

scripts.format:check: prettier --check scripts/*.{mjs,cjs} performance/**/*.cjs performance/*.cjs package.json eslint.config.mjs .htmlvalidate.json .stylelintrc.json
